greeting: Hey, hey... feel the rhythm. Steel-Drum Stellan, at your service.
The metal sings, friend. You just gotta listen.
Welcome to the groove zone. No rush, no worry, just beats.
Back for more steel-drum soul? I got plenty to give.
The heat's high, but the vibes are chill. That's the Stellan way.
Grab a drink. Grab a seat. Let the rhythm move your feet.
I don't just play drums. I play... emotions. Heavy, right?
The forge has heat. I have beats. Together? Perfect harmony.
dialog.performance_invite: I'm on at eight. Steel drums in a magma zone - where else you gonna hear THAT?
dialog.steel_drum_origin: Found these drums in a Dustbelt junkyard. Fixed 'em up. Added some... thermal enhancements. Now they sing.
dialog.musical_philosophy: Music's like metal. Gotta heat it up, hammer it out, let it cool into something beautiful. Deep, right?
dialog.zone_inspiration: Ember's all about contrast. Hot and cool. Loud and quiet. I play the spaces between.
dialog.song_requests: Requests? Sure, I take requests. Can't promise I'll play 'em. I follow the groove, not the crowd.
rumor: Tide's got shanties that'll break your heart. Salt water and sorrow, man.
Mire's music is... swampy. Not my style, but I respect it.
Frost has ice instruments. Bell tones. Ethereal. Too cold for me, though.
Heard there's a synth player in Prism. Electronic. FUTURE, man.
dialog.lucha_collaboration: El Scorcho wants me to play his entrance music. I'm thinking something... dramatic. With FIRE SOUNDS!
farewell: Keep it groovy, friend. The rhythm goes with you.
Don't let the heat steal your cool.
Come back when you need your soul soothed. Steel-drum style.
Peace, love, and percussion. That's the Stellan guarantee.
dialog.time_dawn: Morning warm-up. Gentle rhythms. The day wakes slow.
dialog.time_noon: Midday practice. Working on new material. Hotter beats.
dialog.time_dusk: Showtime! The crowd flows in. The music flows out.
dialog.time_night: Late night grooves. For the night owls and the soul searchers.

party_reactions.kade: You're so... cool. Is it the sunglasses? Or the attitude?
party_reactions.nix7: Musical proficiency detected. Emotional resonance: anomalous for environment.
party_reactions.twist: DRUMS! Can I play?! I'll be gentle! Mostly!
party_reactions.korr: Music calms the spirit. Even in chaos.
party_reactions.renna: The thermal modifications to your drums are fascinating. May I examine them?
party_reactions.suresh: Art soothes where words fail. Your music is... soothing.
party_reactions.sova: Not usually my scene. But... this is nice.
party_reactions.grit: Reminds me of camp music. Between the battles. Good times.
party_reactions.ashka: Your fire is... different. Quiet. I like it.
party_reactions.senna: I could hide in this rhythm. Blend in. Useful.
party_reactions.callum: This is so relaxing! Can you play something... happier?

relationship_dialog.stranger: Hey, new face. Enjoy the vibe.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You're back. Must like the music. Or the heat.
relationship_dialog.friend: My friend! Got a new composition I want you to hear.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You get it. The rhythm, the heat, the soul. Here - my spare drumsticks. You're family now.
